cases.name: minimal
cases.why: one log, one witness, one quorum

cases.name: no-trailing-newline
cases.why: the final line's newline is optional

cases.name: blank-and-whitespace-lines
cases.why: a line that is empty, or only spaces and tabs, is ignored

evaluate.why: a nested group counts as one member, met as its own threshold decides
inner is `any` of pi and vps

cases.name: nested-group
cases.why: a group may name a group; it counts as one member, satisfied or not

evaluate.why: the log line is not what a quorum is about

cases.name: no-log-line
cases.why: `log` is not required by the grammar: the trust file carries the log key

cases.name: comment-and-indent
cases.why: a line whose first non-space character is `#` is ignored, and leading spaces and tabs are not part of a field

cases.name: bad-vertical-tab
cases.why: only ASCII space and tab separate fields, anywhere in a line

cases.name: bad-duplicate-name
cases.why: a name is defined once

cases.name: bad-forward-reference
cases.why: a group names previously-defined members only

cases.name: bad-two-quorums
cases.why: there is exactly one quorum line

cases.name: bad-no-quorum
cases.why: there is exactly one quorum line

cases.name: bad-empty-group
cases.why: a group has at least one member

cases.name: bad-unknown-keyword
cases.why: every line is one of the four directives

cases.name: bad-quorum-undefined
cases.why: the quorum names something the policy defines

cases.name: bad-duplicate-member
cases.why: no member twice -- `2 of pi pi` is met by one witness

cases.name: bad-k-zero
cases.why: 1 <= k <= n -- k=0 is met by nobody, so an uncosigned head passes

cases.name: bad-k-leading-zero
cases.why: k is canonical decimal: two spellings of a quorum are two policies that look different and are not

cases.name: bad-carriage-return
cases.why: only ASCII space and tab; `bad-vertical-tab` covers only one of the three

cases.name: bad-uppercase-keyword
cases.why: the four directives are lowercase

cases.name: bad-extra-field
cases.why: a directive takes the fields its production allows and no more

cases.name: comment-tab-indented
cases.why: the indent before a `#` is spaces *and tabs*; only-U+0020 reads this line as a directive named `#`

cases.name: bad-trailing-comment
cases.why: `#` after a directive's fields is an ordinary character, so this is a `quorum` line with two names; a reader that strips from `#` accepts it

cases.name: witness-url-fragment
cases.why: a `#` inside a field is content: a reader for which `#` is illegal anywhere refuses a URL with a fragment in it

cases.name: bad-duplicate-key
cases.why: a verifier key appears once: under two names, one cosignature line would count as two witnesses

cases.name: bad-log-key-as-witness
cases.why: the same rule across directives: the log's key on a `witness` line is the key twice

cases.name: two-log-lines
cases.why: the grammar permits more than one `log` line; only a trust file's correspondence rule limits it to one

cases.name: bad-form-feed
cases.why: 0x0C is one of the three characters that are errors

cases.name: bad-vertical-tab-in-url
cases.why: 0x0B is an error, not content: kept as content, this URL parses

cases.name: bad-form-feed-in-url
cases.why: 0x0C is an error, not content: kept as content, this URL parses

cases.name: bad-carriage-return-in-url
cases.why: 0x0D is an error, not content: kept as content, this URL parses

cases.name: nbsp-is-content
cases.why: U+00A0 is not in the closed set, so it is content: a reader that refuses it, or splits on it, refuses a policy this document allows

cases.name: bad-carriage-return-in-comment
cases.why: a comment line is tested for the three error characters before it is ignored: a reader that skips comments first accepts a policy with a 0x0D in one

cases.name: bad-form-feed-in-blank-line
cases.why: a blank line is tested for the three error characters before it is ignored: a line holding only 0x0C is not blank

cases.name: bad-quorum-before-definition
cases.why: a name is used only after it is defined, on the quorum line as on a group line: a reader that resolves the quorum at the end accepts this

cases.name: bad-witness-named-none
cases.why: `none` is reserved: both parsers here let a witness take the name and then read `quorum none` as no quorum at all

cases.name: bad-group-named-like-witness
cases.why: one namespace: a group may not take a witness's name, or `quorum pi` means two things

cases.name: trailing-separator
cases.why: a run of spaces and tabs after the last field is not a field: a reader for which it is an empty field refuses this

cases.name: bad-trailing-comment-no-space
cases.why: `#` after a field is an ordinary character, so `pi#note` is one name nothing defines; a reader that strips from `#` reads `quorum pi` and accepts

comment: SPEC 9.1's restated `tlog-policy` grammar, one whole policy per rule, each differing from a valid one in exactly one way. A case with `accept` true MUST parse; the rest MUST be refused. The text is the file verbatim -- some cases turn on whether it ends in a newline. A case with `evaluate` also says what its quorum MEANS: each entry gives a set of cosigner names and whether they satisfy it, which is the only way a reader's arithmetic can be checked

bad-carriage-return-in-comment.says: tested for the three error characters below **before** it is ignored

bad-duplicate-key.says: a verifier key appears **once** in a policy

bad-empty-group.says: `group` a name, a threshold and one or more members

bad-extra-field.says: a line with more is an **error**

bad-form-feed-in-blank-line.says: tested for the three error characters below **before** it is ignored

bad-group-named-like-witness.says: a `group` may not take a `witness`'s name

bad-log-key-as-witness.says: a verifier key appears **once** in a policy

bad-quorum-before-definition.says: on a `group` line and on the `quorum` line alike

bad-quorum-undefined.says: it names a witness, a group, or the reserved name `none`

blank-and-whitespace-lines.says: holds only spaces and tabs, is **ignored**

comment-and-indent.says: spaces and tabs before the keyword

comment-tab-indented.says: first character other than ASCII space or tab

minimal.says: The rest of the grammar, stated because

nbsp-is-content.says: every other Unicode whitespace character included (U+00A0

nested-group.says: counts as **one** member of the outer group

no-trailing-newline.says: the last directive need not end in one

trailing-separator.says: and after the last field, are not part of any field
